lessons: Redo the full ticket from the merge base: add CommitLock and CommitLockTimeout in chupa/lockfile.py, take the lock inside Git.commit, merge_squash, add and restore in chupa/git.py, wire every composition root, and update the doctor row order. Review found this wiring sound.

Have the shared commit_lock helper in tests/integration/test_git.py take the directory the lock lives in, such as a test's tmp_path or the repo's .chupa/state, and pass it from every caller. Never hard-code /tmp or any other fixed system path. The helper must leave no directories behind after a run.

In tests/unit/test_commit_lock.py, make the fake lock count enters or tag each git call with a hold id. Assert that commit(only=paths) makes exactly one enter covering update-index, diff, commit and rev-parse, and that merge_squash makes one enter covering merge and its commit.

Harness callers (daemon_soak, reliability_battery, shakeout, host_loop) must root their CommitLock under a directory they already create and clean up, such as their fixture repo's .chupa/state. They must not use a fresh temp path.
Do not reuse an earlier candidate. Rebuild it, then run ./dev.py test and confirm exit 0 before you finish.
